description: Ministry of Roads & Highways  - Southern Expressway (Kottawa-Mattala) as a User Fee National  Highway
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a legal order under Section 11 of the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It designates a specific highway as a "User Fee National Highway" and revokes previous orders. The content focuses on regulatory action, legal authority (minister acting under statutory powers), and amendment/revocation of previous legal instruments. While a minister is named, this is in the context of executing legal/regulatory functions rather than detailing personal portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes. The core substance is regulatory implementation of existing legislation.
